content: {"praised": ["Solid action thriller with strong pacing in first three-quarters.", "Strong cast, especially Robert Shaw, delivering compelling performances.", "Riveting script ahead of its time, addressing terrorism themes.", "Director John Frankenheimer’s skill evident in suspenseful storytelling.", "Engaging tone blending thriller and political intrigue."], "criticized": ["Final act filled with improbable events and anti-climactic special effects.", "Some scenes crimped, notably a nudity cut that disrupted flow.", "Last part feels like a generic James Bond movie, less serious.", "Certain plot elements feel too far-fetched before 9/11.", "Special effects and tone shift reduce overall impact."]}
